008package paint.viewer.ui;
009
010import paint.shared.config.paintconfig.PaintConfig;
011import paint.viewer.model.RecordingEntry;
012import paint.viewer.ui.panels.SquareGridPanel;
013import paint.viewer.ui.panels.RecordingAttributesPanel;
014
015import javax.swing.*;
016import java.awt.Color;
017
018import static paint.shared.constants.PaintStringConstants.GENERATE_SQUARES;
019import static paint.shared.constants.PaintStringConstants.NUMBER_OF_SQUARES_IN_RECORDING;
020
021import static paint.shared.constants.PaintGeometry.NUMBER_PIXELS_HEIGHT;
022import static paint.shared.constants.PaintGeometry.NUMBER_PIXELS_WIDTH;
023
024/**
025 * Utility class responsible for synchronizing the UI with a newly selected
026 * {@link RecordingEntry}. Called whenever the user navigates between recordings
027 * in the viewer.
028 *
029 * <p>This updater replaces the displayed grid, rescaled images, labels, and
030 * attribute table to reflect the active recording. No state is stored inside
031 * this class—its job is to apply a complete UI refresh against the components
032 * provided to the constructor.</p>
033 */
034public final class RecordingDisplayUpdater {
035
036    private final SquareGridPanel          leftGridPanel;
037    private final JLabel                   rightImageLabel;
038    private final JLabel                   experimentLabel;
039    private final JLabel                   recordingLabel;
040    private final RecordingAttributesPanel attributesPanel;
041    private final Color                    defaultRecordingLabelColor;
042
043    /**
044     * Creates a new updater bound to the UI components it controls.
045     *
046     * @param leftGridPanel     the grid used for displaying square layout and overlays
047     * @param rightImageLabel   the label used to show the right-side image
048     * @param experimentLabel   the label displaying the experiment name
049     * @param recordingLabel    the label displaying the recording name
050     * @param attributesPanel   the table panel showing recording metadata
051     */
052    public RecordingDisplayUpdater(
053            SquareGridPanel leftGridPanel,
054            JLabel rightImageLabel,
055            JLabel experimentLabel,
056            JLabel recordingLabel,
057            RecordingAttributesPanel attributesPanel
058    ) {
059        this.leftGridPanel              = leftGridPanel;
060        this.rightImageLabel            = rightImageLabel;
061        this.experimentLabel            = experimentLabel;
062        this.recordingLabel             = recordingLabel;
063        this.attributesPanel            = attributesPanel;
064        this.defaultRecordingLabelColor = recordingLabel.getForeground();
065    }
066
067    /**
068     * Updates all UI components to show the given recording entry.
069     *
070     * @param entry      the new {@link RecordingEntry} to display
071     * @param index      the zero-based index of the entry in the full list
072     * @param totalSize  the total number of loaded recording entries
073     */
074    public void show(RecordingEntry entry, int index, int totalSize) {
075
076        // --- Left grid panel ---
077        leftGridPanel.setBackgroundImage(entry.getLeftImage());
078        leftGridPanel.setSquares(entry.getRecording().getSquaresOfRecording());
079
080        // --- Right image ---
081        // A recording may have no brightfield image (none on disk, or the file failed to load).
082        // Show an empty panel rather than throwing an NPE out of the display update.
083        ImageIcon rightImage = entry.getRightImage();
084        if (rightImage == null || rightImage.getImage() == null) {
085            rightImageLabel.setIcon(null);
086        } else {
087            rightImageLabel.setIcon(new ImageIcon(
088                    rightImage.getImage().getScaledInstance(
089                            NUMBER_PIXELS_WIDTH,
090                            NUMBER_PIXELS_HEIGHT,
091                            java.awt.Image.SCALE_SMOOTH
092                    )
093            ));
094        }
095
096        // --- Labels ---
097        experimentLabel.setText(
098                "Experiment: " + entry.getExperimentName()
099                        + "   [" + (index + 1) + "/" + totalSize + "]"
100        );
101
102        applyExcludedUi(entry);
103
104        // --- Attribute table ---
105        int numberOfSquares = PaintConfig.getInt(
106                GENERATE_SQUARES,
107                NUMBER_OF_SQUARES_IN_RECORDING,
108                -1
109        );
110
111        attributesPanel.updateFromEntry(entry, numberOfSquares);
112
113        // --- Refresh grid ---
114        leftGridPanel.repaint();
115    }
116
117    /**
118     * Updates the recording label to reflect whether the current recording is excluded.
119     * If excluded, appends "(Excluded)" and sets the label text to red.
120     */
121    public void applyExcludedUi(RecordingEntry entry) {
122        final boolean excluded = isExcluded(entry);
123        if (excluded) {
124            recordingLabel.setText("Recording: " + entry.getRecordingName() + " (Excluded)");
125            recordingLabel.setForeground(Color.RED);
126        } else {
127            recordingLabel.setText("Recording: " + entry.getRecordingName());
128            recordingLabel.setForeground(defaultRecordingLabelColor);
129        }
130    }
131
132    /**
133     * Attempts to read an "excluded" flag from the RecordingEntry / Recording model.
134     */
135    private static boolean isExcluded(RecordingEntry recordingEntry) {
136        if (recordingEntry == null) {
137            return false;
138        }
139
140        return recordingEntry.getRecording().isExcluded();
141    }
142}
